async def trigger_event_stream_replay(
    replay_job_id: str,
    request: Request,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_db)
):
    dispatcher: EventDispatcher = request.app.state.event_dispatcher
    job = await db.get(ReplayJobRecord, replay_job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Replay job not found")
    await dispatcher.enqueue_replay(job.stream_name, job.start_sequence, job.end_sequence)

diagnosis: The endpoint enqueues a stream replay into the lifespan app.state.event_dispatcher without ensuring job.creator_tenant_id == current_user.tenant_id. Any user can replay historical event streams belonging to other tenants, potentially causing duplicate downstream webhook triggers or state corruption.

corrected_code:
@app.post("/api/v1/event-pipeline/replays/{replay_job_id}/start")
async def trigger_event_stream_replay(
    replay_job_id: str,
    request: Request,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_db)
):
    dispatcher: EventDispatcher = request.app.state.event_dispatcher
    stmt = select(ReplayJobRecord).where(
        ReplayJobRecord.id == replay_job_id,
        ReplayJobRecord.creator_tenant_id == current_user.tenant_id
    )
    res = await db.execute(stmt)
    job = res.scalar_one_or_none()
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Replay job not found")
    await dispatcher.enqueue_replay(job.stream_name, job.start_sequence, job.end_sequence)
    job.status = "replaying"
    await db.commit()
    return {"status": "replay_initiated", "job_id": replay_job_id}
